requirements.title: NEAREST returns a distinct adjacent machine number in S direction
requirements.definition: The NEAREST result is the machine-representable number distinct from X and nearest to X in the direction of infinity with the same sign as S; opposite signs of S produce results that bracket X.

pending.NEAREST-positive-S-result-greater-than-X: Use X=1.0 and S=1.0, initialize a real sentinel away from X, compute NEAREST, and assert the result is greater than X and distinct. Mutate S to -1.0 so the direction check fails; no exact spacing is asserted.
pending.NEAREST-negative-S-result-less-than-X: Use X=1.0 and S=-1.0, compute NEAREST, and assert the result is less than X and distinct. Mutate S to 1.0 so the direction check fails; no exact spacing is asserted.
pending.NEAREST-result-distinct-from-X: Pair the positive-S and negative-S controls and assert each result differs from X, with direction checks proving the difference is load-bearing.
pending.NEAREST-opposite-directions-bracket-X: Use X=1.0, compute LO=NEAREST(X,-1.0) and HI=NEAREST(X,1.0), and assert LO < X, X < HI, LO /= X, HI /= X, and LO /= HI. Mutate one S sign so the bracketing relation fails; no exact adjacent value is asserted.
